report:
Reviewed the complete claim and all associations. The ordinary implementation in sage_meta::spec::validate_implementations visits every anchor and emits a diagnostic for either absent or empty rust.implementations entries. It never consults tests or item correspondences. Any nonempty explicit implementation entry satisfies this coverage check regardless of placeholder status; the immutable access does not relabel entries. Thus required-entry, missing-entry error, independence from test/item mappings, and placeholder counting are accounted for at this validation boundary.

The complete ordinary test tests_and_model_correspondence_do_not_replace_explicit_implementation_entries constructs both item correspondence and annotated test evidence, asserts test validation succeeds, and then asserts exactly one missing-implementation diagnostic with the expected message. Its captured source helper only constructs SpecSource. The second associated test, todo::independent_implementation_coverage, is an explicit empty TODO, not behavioral evidence. Its comment reserves the missing-entry/placeholder-status scenarios; the first portion now has ordinary coverage, while comprehensive explicit-placeholder/status assertions remain deferred. Completing that TODO requires fixtures declaring placeholder implementation entries and assertions that they satisfy coverage while retaining their explicit statuses (and missing/empty-entry controls). This accepted deferral remains visible; no implemented test coverage is claimed for it.

Baseline verification: exact comparison with the supplied historical input confirmed spec.rs implementation and spec_plan.rs test source unchanged. The sole spec.rs test-file delta migrates an unrelated review-inventory assertion from claim to a Claim fragment; captured current delta was inspected and does not alter this anchor's test/helper or coverage behavior. Reassessed the historical rationale against current claim, full supplied test bodies, metadata and implementation rather than treating comparison as approval.

Execution: personally ran review start with the supplied instructions and review read to capture relied-on helper, changed-source context and review rules; no behavioral tests or builds were run by this reviewer. The 321 passing tests and root build are coordinator-reported baseline results only. No source edits or behavioral defects identified. All ordinary and TODO evidence is accounted for; no requested edits.
